comparison_notes: This is an exploratory follow-up to learned-from-two orders moving above three, not confirmation of long memory, optimal order or convergence. No arm is selected after viewing this study's endpoints.

All arms have 1537 trainable parameters: independent zero local/history gates and one log-alpha initialized at log(2). Initialization does not consume RNG. Seeds vary paired minibatch order, not independent corpora.

Short history has K=3 (two past taps); full history has K=32 (31 past taps). Raw history uses unnormalized Rust GL; L2 history fixes the entire declared strictly-past coefficient norm to sqrt(5), rounded to float32 by the Rust binding. At alpha=2 all four filters start with taps [-2, 1] and all adapters are identity maps.

Only the filter energy is fixed, not hidden-state variance, residual amplitude after gates, or the optimizer's step geometry. Full-kernel normalization is not prefix-adaptive. Removing gain freedom changes the order derivative and optimization path, so this factorial does not isolate a unique memory mechanism.

Primary contrasts: raw-full minus raw-short; L2-full minus L2-short; L2-short minus raw-short; L2-full minus raw-full; and (L2-full minus L2-short) minus (raw-full minus raw-short). Negative CE favors the positive-weight arm; a negative interaction means the length contrast is more favorable with normalization.

Require paired initial parameter hashes, capacities, first-update losses/gate receipts and batch schedules. Subsequent trajectories are expected to differ because these are different learned maps, not same-math implementations. Preserve any failed initial criterion and all losing outcomes.

Complete all twelve 512-update runs and 24 continuation-only updates before endpoint evaluation. Development does not select checkpoints, hyperparameters, duration or reported arms. The frozen no-adapter model is the shared zero-update baseline.

Raw-full repeats the preceding learned-from-two recipe from scratch using the current frozen native runtime. Compare its losses, gate/order tensors, named Adam state and endpoint receipts with the historical run separately; do not pool repeats as independent seeds.

Pride/Alice are reused exploratory endpoints, potentially in pretraining, not pristine confirmation. Shared evaluation blocks and three minibatch-order seeds do not support significance, general-LLM superiority or a unique fractional-memory claim.

CPU float32, frozen local GPT-2, complete unpadded contexts, no KV cache or packed documents. History resets at each 128-token block. Model, data and update budgets match, but short/full operator arithmetic differs; wall time is not a speed benchmark.
